news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 25-of-33 passing attempts for 222 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Matthew Stafford throws two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Stafford looked pretty good on Sunday. He threw for over 200 yards and two touchdowns over the course of the afternoon, but that wasn't enough for the Rams, as they still put up just 16 points and suffered a loss at the hands of the Cardinals. Stafford should continue to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 30 of 41 passes for 321 yards and three touchdowns while rushing twice for six yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes throws three touchdowns in Week 8
news.impact: Mahomes threw touchdowns to Rashee Rice, Emmett Johnson, and Noah Gray without turning the ball over. He also surpassed 300 passing yards for the first time this season. After failing to throw a touchdown against the Chargers in Week 6, Mahomes returned to QB1 production against Denver. He's back.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 19 of his 33 passes for 165 yards and one interception while adding two rushes for 14 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II struggles vs. Seahawks in Week 7
news.impact: Mahomes and the Kansas City offense struggled in the loss to Seattle on Sunday night as they were held without a touchdown for the first time all season while being dealt their first loss. Mahomes will take nine touchdown passes and four interceptions into his Week 8 matchup against the Broncos.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mahomes will be good to go for Sunday's showdown in Seattle.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes completed 23 of 30 passes for 272 yards, zero touchdowns and one interception while adding 16 yards on five carries in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes Throws for 272 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Mahomes moved the ball efficiently at 9.1 yards per attempt, but Kenneth Walker III scored both of Kansas City's touchdowns on the ground. The interception didn't help, either, leaving Mahomes with a disappointing fantasy performance despite the Chiefs putting up 422 total yards. There isn't much to overthink here -- Mahomes remains a high-end QB1 going forward.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 10 of 14 passes for 210 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence torches Colts with only 10 completions
news.impact: It simply does not get much more efficient than Lawrence's performance Sunday afternoon. The Jags' ringleader averaged 21 yards on his 10 completions, connecting with seven different receivers. Lawrence added 10 yards on three carries and did not throw an interception. He did lose a fumble, but that was his only real blemish. Lawrence has completed 65.7% of his throws this season, averaging over 240 yards with an impressive 17-4 TD/INT ratio through seven games.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24-of-41 passes for 306 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in a 34-31 loss to Houston. He added 11 rushing yards on three carries.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence tosses four touchdowns in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Lawrence and the Jaguars' offense turned heavily to the passing game in the second half after falling behind Houston early. Lawrence was able to top 300 yards passing for the second straight game and set a new season high in passing attempts. Lawrence and the Jaguars will head to a bye in Week 7.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence clears 300 yards for the first time this season
news.impact: Lawrence not only passed for a new season-high in yards Sunday, but he also gained 25 yards on the ground for the second time through the first five weeks. Lawrence is averaging just under 235 passing yards per game on the campaign, with a 67.1% completion rate and a 10-3 TD/INT ratio. He'll face the division-rival Texans in Week 6, and remains a definite QB1.

news.body: Trevor Lawrence completed 18-of-23 passing attempts for 227 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Trevor Lawrence scores once in win Sunday
news.impact: Lawrence was able to lead the Jaguars to a win on Sunday, but he wasn't able to rack up many fantasy points in the process, finishing with just one touchdown over the course of the afternoon. Almost all of Jacksonville's fantasy options disappointed in this matchup, but they should be able to bounce back in a competitive matchup against the Eagles next week.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 30 of 38 passes for 278 yards, a touchdown, and a pick in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He was the Saints' leading rusher with seven yards on three carries.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws for 278 yards in loss
news.impact: Shough didn't have a terrible game, all things considered. He was accurate, put up decent yardage, but was just held out of the end zone. Obviously, that's a big part of fantasy football, but it's also important to remember that because the Saints had no running game, it made things a little tougher for Shough in the passing game.

news.body: Tyler Shough completed 16-of-30 passes for 144 yards and three touchdowns in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Tyler Shough throws three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Shough continues to play through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. After a slow start in the first quarter, he had a solid afternoon the rest of the game. He also added another touchdown on the ground. He'll face the Steelers next week.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: The young quarterback's hand injury isn't serious and hasn't affected his participation at practice all week thus far. He should play and will be looking to bounce back on Sunday after a disappointing performance in Week 5.

news.body: Tyler Shough (hand) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Shough (hand) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: The young quarterback was able to practice in a full capacity on Wednesday, despite still dealing with a hand issue of some kind. He should be good to go for Week 6, however, and this issue shouldn't play a big factor for fantasy managers when they weigh whether or not to start him against the Giants this week.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. rushed five times for 22 yards while also catching both of his targets for 18 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. held in check in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Jones Sr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 30 yards in each of his last two contests. The running back faces another stiff test against the Buffalo Bills in Week 9.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday and Friday. He will be an RB2/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. practiced again on Friday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) practices Friday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice on Thursday after he missed practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report, but he appears to be on track to being good to go.

news.body: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returned to Minnesota's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Jones returned to practice for the Vikings on Thursday after being sidelined by a knee issue on Wednesday. It remains to be seen whether he was limited or a full participant, but either way this bodes well for his Week 8 availability.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) missed New Orleans' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (rest/back) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's managing a back issue right now, and the team also wanted to give him the day off for load management purposes. His participation at Thursday's practice should be much more revealing for his Week 9 availability.

news.body: Alvin Kamara ran six times for five yards and caught all seven of his targets for 57 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to Pittsburgh on Sunday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara catches seven passes in win
news.impact: After averaging four yards per carry or better in his previous two contests, Kamara was held in check in this one. He got there in fantasy thanks to his receiving production, something those who started him can be grateful for. His role may change after the bye, but the pass-catching should remain a staple for him.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (back) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: To no surprise, Kamara was left limited for another practice on Thursday due to the back injury that he's managing. He should play in Week 7, but it remains unlikely that he will have a strong performance from a fantasy perspective.

news.body: Alvin Kamara (back) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Alvin Kamara (back) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kamara was limited by a back injury on Wednesday, but that has been common for him over the course of the season and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 7. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed for nine yards on two carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets. He caught 3-of-4 targets for 64 yards.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty sees just two carries in Week 8 win
news.impact: Jeanty saw the bulk of the rushing attempts go to Mike Washington Jr. in the win Sunday. After the game, it was made clear that this was the plan and was communicated to Jeanty prior to the game. Fantasy managers will want to monitor reports from the Raiders heading into Week 9.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed eight times for 15 yards while also hauling in all eight of his targets for 61 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty finds end zone in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Jeanty has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording a touchdown in each of the last two contests. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of an inconsistent New York Jets offense in Week 8.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty rushed the ball ten times for 22 yards and a touchdown and caught 4-of-6 targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty inefficient in loss Sunday
news.impact: Jeanty ended up having a decent fantasy outing on Sunday between his involvement in the receiving game and his touchdown on the ground. But he was very inefficient on the ground, rushing at a clip of just 2.2 yards per carry, and finished with less rushing yards than Mike Washington Jr., who was more involved than expected again Buffalo. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor Jeanty moving forward, especially to see if he's still dealing with any nagging injuries at this point.

news.body: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Ashton Jeanty (foot) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: There has been some recent speculation that Jeanty is not at full health, but while he is listed on Las Vegas' injury report, he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be good to go for Week 6. Fantasy managers should continue to start him, but after a slow start to the season, they should have tempered expectations for his efficiency for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is officially questionable for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) officially questionable for Thursday
news.impact: Tuten wasn't able to practice all week due to an ankle/foot issue that he's dealing with, and now he is officially considered questionable to play on Thursday night because of it. It sounds like he is expected to be a game-time decision, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his status leading up to kickoff and should have a good backup option in place in case he's out.

news.body: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Bhayshul Tuten could be a game-time decision for Thursday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) could be game-time decision Thursday
news.impact: Tuten will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Thursday. Chris Rodriguez would be next up if he is sidelined.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten did not practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) officially misses practice Tuesday
news.impact: Tuten opens the week with back-to-back missed practices. His status will need to be monitored closely on Wednesday.

news.body: Bhayshul Tuten was not seen practicing on Tuesday.
news.head: Bhayshul Tuten (foot) not practicing Tuesday
news.impact: Tuten was also listed as a DNP on Monday. With Jacksonville playing on Thursday, he'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Wednesday.

news.body: Bijan Robinson ran for 76 yards on 19 carries in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson runs for 76 yards Sunday
news.impact: Robinson did not catch his lone target. It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense. Bijan remains an RB1 heading into next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Bijan Robinson rushed for 63 yards on 20 carries and caught all five of his targets for 59 yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Bijan Robinson gains 122 yards of total offense in Week 7 win
news.impact: Robinson finished with just over 60 yards on the ground for the second straight week, but he nearly doubled his offensive output with his efforts in the passing game. Robinson hasn't visited the end zone since Week 4, and fantasy managers hope that will change in a Week 8 matchup with the Buccaneers. Robinson remains one of the top overall fantasy assets despite this short dry spell.

news.body: Bijan Robinson carried the ball nine times for 61 yards while also catching both of his targets for a loss of eight yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Bijan Robinson bottled up in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Robinson struggled to make an impact out of the backfield, recording less than 70 offensive yards for the first time in six contests. The running back remains locked in as a strong RB1 option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Bijan Robinson gained 86 yards on 17 carries and caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Bijan Robinson totals 118 yards on 21 touches in Week 5
news.impact: Robinson continues to be one of the elite offensive weapons in the league, as the dual-threat back is averaging 116 rushing yards and more than 30 receiving yards per game this season. Robinson scored twice on the ground in both Week 3 and Week 4, but he couldn't keep the TD streak going Sunday night against the Ravens. He will look to start a new one in Week 6 against the Bears.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball 11 times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Blake Corum leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Corum played well on Sunday. He led the team with 73 yards over the course of the game, and he was able to do that while maintaining an efficient clip of 6.6 yards per carry. His touchdown was the cherry on top, and fantasy managers should expect him to continue to see considerable work moving forward, even while sharing the backfield with Kyren Williams.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed 17 times for 93 yards and one touchdown while also catching his only target for eight yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Blake Corum reaches end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Corum has had a nose for the end zone of late, recording one touchdown in each of his last three contests. The dynamic running back remains an impactful option behind No. 1 running back Kyren Williams for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the winless Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Blake Corum rushed the ball nine times for 42 yards and caught two passes for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Blake Corum scores once in loss Sunday
news.impact: Corum got involved on Sunday, seeing 11 total touches in the team's loss to the Cardinals. He was able to get into the end zone on one of his catches, but he still didn't end up with more than just a solid fantasy total. He will likely continue to serve as an involved RB2 behind Kyren Williams moving forward.

news.body: Blake Corum carried the ball five times for 19 yards and a touchdown while catching three of his four targets for 53 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Blake Corum finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: While still playing behind starter Kyren Williams, Corum turned in his most productive game of the year in the Monday night loss. He found the end zone for his first touchdown of the season on a one-yard run in the third quarter. Corum will remain a top fantasy handcuff behind Williams, but he is still just a low-end flex option in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Braelon Allen rushed for 147 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders. He caught both of his targets for six yards.
news.head: Braelon Allen excellent in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Allen set a new career high in rushing yards and has been excellent as the starting running back with Breece Hall (quad) out for the fifth straight game. Allen has tallied over 100 rushing yards in three of those five games and will likely remain a key part of the Jets' offense in Week 9 against the Chiefs.

news.body: Braelon Allen (ankle) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Braelon Allen (ankle) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Allen will be available to play on Sunday, despite being listed on the injury report earlier in the week due to an ankle injury. He should be a full go in Week 8 and will be New York's primary running back if Breece Hall (quad) is unable to suit up against the Raiders.

news.body: Braelon Allen (ankle) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Braelon Allen (ankle) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Allen was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday after being limited by an ankle issue on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should expect him to be startable again if Breece Hall (quad) is ruled out for another game.

news.body: Braelon Allen will be limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Braelon Allen to be limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allen and Breece Hall will both be limited to start the practice week. They'll need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Hall was a limited participant to start the week on Wednesday. He seems to be very close to a return from his quad injury, but there also remains a slight chance that he will be traded in the near future, so fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status closely throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play in Week 9.

news.body: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said Breece Hall is “trending in the right direction.”
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) trending in right direction
news.impact: Hall continues to trend in the right direction to return in Week 9 against the Chiefs. What his exact role will be remains uncertain.

news.body: Jets RB Breece Hall is expected to return in Week 9 against the Chiefs.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) expected to return in Week 9
news.impact: Hall was limited in practice all week last week and listed as questionable before he was limited. He should have another week of practice before he is expected to return on Sunday.

news.body: Breece Hall (quad) is inactive for Week 8 for the New York Jets against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Breece Hall (quad) inactive for Week 8
news.impact: Hall will remain sidelined once again for head coach Aaron Glenn, with Braelon Allen once again in line for a sizeable workload leading the Jets backfield Sunday.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran for 170 yards and a touchdown on 27 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Bucky Irving explodes for 170 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was the Irving and Kenneth Gainwell show all afternoon as Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. Irving saw career-highs in both carries and yardage. He also had a second touchdown taken away on a fumble at the goal line. He'll be a borderline RB1 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Bucky Irving did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (rest) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: It was a rest day for Irving. He should be back at practice on Friday.

news.body: Bucky Irving ran 24 times for 106 yards and two touchdowns in the Bucs' 43-13 win over Carolina. He also caught one of two targets for four yards.
news.head: Bucky Irving gashes Carolina in win
news.impact: Irving has put up strong performances of late, with 100+ rushing yards and 1+ rushing touchdowns in two of his last three games played. He's firmly in RB2 territory with RB1 upside.

news.body: Bucky Irving (illness) was back at practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
news.head: Bucky Irving (illness) back at practice Thursday
news.impact: Irving is currently recovering from an illness of some kind and missed Wednesday's practice as a result, but he was back at practice on Thursday and participated in a limited capacity. That's a good sign that he will be fully good to go for Sunday's game against the Panthers.

news.body: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Cam Skattebo remains day-to-day.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) remains day-to-day
news.impact: Skattebo did not practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Cam Skattebo was working on the side with a trainer during practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) working on side with trainer Wednesday
news.impact: It is another absence from practice for Skattebo. His status for Week 9 is up in the air.

news.body: Cam Skattebo was practicing on a side field on Monday with trainers.
news.head: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices on side field Monday
news.impact: Skattebo injured his hamstring on a long run against the Texans before the Giants bye week. He will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: Cam Skattebo ran for 124 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Cam Skattebo records strong performance Sunday
news.impact: Skattebo appeared to injure his hamstring late in the win. He impressed in his first game back since being benched last week. He'll need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.

news.body: Chase Brown carried the ball 12 times for 55 yards while catching eight of his nine targets for 46 yards and losing a fumble in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Chase Brown catches eight passes in Week 8
news.impact: Brown did most of his damage in the passing game in the thrilling win over Tennessee. More importantly, he out-touched Samaje Perine 20-to-five in the contest after Perine had been cutting into his workload in recent weeks. Brown will continue to be a low-end RB1/high-end RB2 as he prepares to face the Falcons in Week 9.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed for 39 yards on 11 carries in a 35-13 win over the Ravens. He caught 4-of-5 passes for 19 yards.
news.head: Chase Brown sees 15 touches in Week 7 win
news.impact: Brown continues to struggle in the running game and saw Samaje Perine get the goal line carry that resulted in the Bengals' lone rushing touchdown. Brown has not eclipsed 50 rushing yards since Week 3 and has failed to find the end zone since Week 1. Brown and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball 13 times for 39 yards and caught 3-of-4 targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Chase Brown underwhelming in win Sunday
news.impact: The young running back wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He totaled 50 yards over his 17 opportunities, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy total. He should bounce back and look better after Cincinnati's bye week this week, but his production may continue to be inconsistent moving forward.

news.body: Chase Brown rushed the ball nine times for ten yards and hauled in 11 catches for 71 yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Chase Brown hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Brown was very ineffective as a rusher on Sunday, finishing with just ten yards in a loss to the Jaguars. He was able to contribute heavily through the passing game, however, logging 71 yards on a whopping 11 catches. The Bengals may need to lean on him in the passing game again next week with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at risk to be sidelined against the Dolphins.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) good to go for Thursday
news.impact: Rodriguez was limited at practice all week due to a hand issue, but it's not a serious issue and he is officially good to go for Thursday night's game. Look for him to see a lot more work than usual if Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) is ruled out against the Ravens.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. (hand) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Rodriguez is on track to be good to go for Thursday’s game against the Ravens. He could be in line for an expanded role with Bhayshul Tuten still sidelined from practice on Tuesday.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez rushed for 41 yards and a touchdown on six carries, adding in a 17-yard reception in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez hits paydirt in Week 8 win
news.impact: Rodriguez continues to be a solid change-of-pace back for the Jaguars. The fourth-year ball carrier scored his third touchdown of the season in the third quarter of this contest, sprinting from 28 yards out for his longest gain of the campaign to date. Rodriguez is averaging 4.6 yards on his 45 carries so far this season and should be considered a top-tier handcuff.

news.body: Chris Rodriguez Jr. rushed for 55 yards on 11 carries in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to Houston. He did not record a reception on his lone target.
news.head: Chris Rodriguez Jr. sees 11 carries in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Rodriguez tallied a better yards per carry average than Bhayshul Tuten, but Tuten was able to get more involved in the passing game. Fantasy managers should expect Tuten to continue to see the bulk of the playing time coming out of the Week 7 bye.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: McCaffrey got banged up in the loss against the Falcons before the bye week. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: The 49ers say RB Christian McCaffrey has a mild hamstring strain.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey dealing with mild hamstring strain
news.impact: McCaffrey briefly left Sunday's game against the Falcons with the injury. 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters that he believes McCaffrey will be ready to play when the team comes out of their Week 8 bye.

news.body: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 39 yards and a touchdown on seven carries, adding six receptions for 61 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey gains 100 yards, scores in Week 7 loss
news.impact: McCaffrey dealt with a thigh injury for a portion of Sunday's game, but he still ended up gaining 100 yards of offense on 13 touches. He also found the end zone on the ground for the eighth time this season. He remains a top-shelf fantasy option.

news.body: 49ers RB Christian McCaffrey (thigh) has returned to the game against the Falcons.
news.head: Christian McCaffrey (thigh) returns to the game
news.impact: McCaffrey suffered a thigh injury in the first half and was listed as questionable to return. The broadcast showed that he was on the sideline working before the start of the half and returned on the team’s first series.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard rushed for 81 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding 38 yards on seven receptions in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard gains 119 yards, scores in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Hubbard delivered a true workhorse effort Thursday night and was certainly one of the main reasons the Panthers hung around until the end of this contest. Hubbard is having a strong season through seven games, averaging 20 touches for close to 100 yards of offense. He has also found the end zone in five of those games.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard ran seven times for 33 yards and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard saved by receiving work in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Hubbard was actually fairly efficient on the ground, the game just got away from Carolina so quickly that he didn't receive many touches. He was greatly helped by his receiving work in PPR formats, with his four receptions tied for the most on the team. He will look to have a better night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returned to practice in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard (rest) returns to full practice Thursday
news.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was a full participant. He should be good to go for Week 7 and remains a must-start fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Chuba Hubbard (rest) was absent from Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Chuba Hubbard (rest) absent from practice Wednesday
news.impact: Hubbard was given the day off on Wednesday as a typical veteran rest day. He should be back on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 7, assuming nothing happens at practice this week.

news.body: The Eagles placed RB Dameon Pierce on injured reserve.
news.head: Dameon Pierce placed on IR
news.impact: Pierce becomes the latest Eagles running back to go down with an injury. He'll miss at least the next four weeks.

news.body: Dameon Pierce rushed the ball 14 times for 47 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Dameon Pierce finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Pierce saw the most carries on the team on Monday night, with Saquon Barkley (hamstring) still having a limited workload in his return game. Barkley seems to have gotten banged up in this game as well, so if he's out next week, Pierce will prove to be startable in a lot of league formats in a matchup against the Commanders on Sunday night next week.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles running back Dameon Pierce carried the ball 12 times for 35 yards and a score and caught four passes for 15 yards in a loss to the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Dameon Pierce scores in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Pierce made his first start since 2023 with Houston. Saquon Barkley is recovering from a hamstring injury, and Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are both on injured reserve, which could make Pierce the starter for another week or two. He is likely to be a touchdown-dependent FLEX option in an offense missing several pieces, though he dominated the backfield touches in Week 6.

news.body: Dameon Pierce gained 14 yards on 11 carries and netted negative yardage on two receptions in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Dameon Pierce does little with 13 touches in Sunday's loss
news.impact: After Will Shipley (foot) exited Sunday's game early, Pierce took on more of the load than expected out of the Eagles' backfield. Pierce was making both his Eagles and regular-season debuts after being elevated this week. Pierce was unable to get much going against a stingy Jacksonville run defense. The beaten-up Philly backfield could get Saquon Barkley back for Week 6.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed the ball 27 times for 69 yards and three touchdowns while adding two catches for ten yards through the air in Monday night's 24-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: D'Andre Swift scores three touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: Swift pulled off the hat trick on Monday night, getting into the end zone three different times in a big win over Seattle. Outside of that he wasn't very efficient and didn't get a lot of work as a receiver, so while his fantasy total was very good, it didn't quite reach dominant levels. He should continue to be a high-end fantasy asset moving forward with how good this Chicago offense looks right now.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed for 78 yards and a touchdown on 22 carries, adding four receptions for 12 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: D'Andre Swift finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: With Kyle Monangai (thumb, toe) still out and Roschon Johnson not very involved, Swift shouldered a workhorse load against the Patriots on Thursday night. The dual-threat back averaged less than 3.5 yards per touch, but he did find the end zone for the seventh time this season, which has him currently tied for second in the NFL in rushing touchdowns. Swift will go up against the Seahawks' defense in Week 8. He remains a low-end RB1 for standard fantasy leagues.

news.body: D'Andre Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone twice in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of his six contests. The running back will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

news.body: D'Andre Swift carried the ball nine times for 43 yards and one touchdown while also catching four of his five targets for 30 yards in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone in Week 5 loss to Packers
news.impact: Swift continues a strong start to the season out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of the first five games. The running back remains a reliable option out of the backfield in all formats, with a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons up next.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 53 yards and a touchdown on 11 carries in a 36-10 loss to the Bills. He caught both of his targets for seven yards.
news.head: Derrick Henry finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Henry found the end zone for the first time since Week 4 against the Titans. With Lamar Jackson (thumb) headed to IR and Tyler Huntley's (toe) status uncertain for Week 9, Henry could be in line for a lot of work against the Jaguars in Week 9.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 45 yards on 17 carries in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals. He caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards.
news.head: Derrick Henry quiet in Week 7 loss
news.impact: The Bengals' defense was able to bottle up Henry all day, leading to his worst performance of the season. The Ravens are hopeful to have Lamar Jackson back in Week 8, which could open up more lanes for Henry against Buffalo.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry ran for 58 yards on 17 carries and caught one pass for two yards in the team's 13-10 loss in Cleveland.
news.head: Derrick Henry gains 60 scoreless yards in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Henry was held scoreless for the first time this season, ending a five-game streak of rushing/receiving touchdowns that had opened the year. He also lost a fumble in the tight contest. Henry's long-term outlook remains strong, but with Lamar Jackson sidelined, there is a lower floor for his output.

news.body: Derrick Henry rushed for 102 yards on 24 carries, adding an 18-yard touchdown reception in Sunday's 30-23 OT win over the Falcons.
news.head: Derrick Henry eclipses 100 yards, catches TD in Week 5
news.impact: Henry picked up 32 of his rushing yards in the Ravens' one overtime possession, but he nevertheless recorded his highest yardage total since Week 1. This was the first time in five games in which Henry did not find the end zone on the ground, but he did come up with his first TD reception of the season. Even in his 11th NFL season, Henry remains among the best running backs in the league.

news.body: Devin Singletary ran for 41 yards and a touchdown on five carries in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Devin Singletary scores winning touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Singletary won the game on a 30-yard in overtime. The Giants are on bye next week, but it is worth noting that Cam Skattebo and Tyrone Tracy both got banged up in this game.

news.body: Devin Singletary is expected to be active for the New York Giants Sunday according to Jordan Raanan.
news.head: Devin Singletary expected to be active Sunday
news.impact: Singletary is part of a backfield shakeup for head coach John Harbaugh after Cam Skattebo’s ball security issues, with the veteran to be part of a four-headed backfield attack along with Najee Harris, Tyrone Tracy Jr, and Skattebo Sunday.

news.body: Giants RB Devin Singletary is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Titans.
news.head: Devin Singletary officially inactive for Week 3
news.impact: Singletary is a healthy inactive for the Giants after averaging just 2.8 yards per carry in the first two games. Najee Harris will serve as the primary backup to Cam Skattebo.

news.body: Devin Singletary rushed the ball three times for nine yards and failed to catch his lone target in Monday's 28-6 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Devin Singletary a non-factor Monday
news.impact: Singletary involvement was minimal on Monday, as he saw just three touches over the course of the game. He wasn't able to do much with those touches, and it was less than ideal to see Najee Harris come in and out-touch him in this matchup. He is off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Dylan Sampson ran for seven yards on one carry in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 6-of-8 targets for 62 yards receiving.
news.head: Dylan Sampson catches six passes Sunday
news.impact: Sampson has now caught 9-of-11 targets across two games since returning from injury. He remains on the flex radar in PPR leagues for fantasy managers.

news.body: Dylan Sampson (knee) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) set to play Sunday
news.impact: Sampson is set to play on Sunday, despite being listed on Cleveland's injury report earlier in the week with a knee issue. He isn't expected to see enough work to be fantasy relevant in this matchup, however.

news.body: Dylan Sampson (knee) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Sampson was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a knee issue to start the week on Wednesday. He should be a full go for Week 8 and will continue to contribute as a depth option behind Quinshon Judkins moving forward.

news.body: Dylan Sampson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dylan Sampson (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Sampson made his return in Week 7. He remains in the flex streaming conversation.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed once for 15 yards while catching all five of his targets for 128 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Emmett Johnson explodes for 143 yards, touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Johnson turned a Patrick Mahomes pass into a 73-yard touchdown and finished with 143 total yards on six touches. So, is there a changing of the guard in Kansas City's backfield? No. Kenneth Walker III had 25 touches compared to six for Johnson. That said, 143 yards on six touches should earn Johnson more opportunities moving forward.

news.body: Emmett Johnson caught two of his three targets for 17 yards in a 20-3 loss to Seattle in Week 7.
news.head: Emmett Johnson catches two balls in Week 7
news.impact: Johnson was not given a carry on a sluggish day for the Chiefs on offense. The rookie running back remains an interesting handcuff for fantasy moving forward. He will take on the Broncos in Week 8.

news.body: Emmett Johnson caught his lone target for a 10-yard gain in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Emmett Johnson hauls in 10-yard pass in Week 4
news.impact: Johnson did not record a carry as Kenneth Walker III dominated the backfield work in the win. Johnson will continue to mix in behind Walker as a high-end fantasy handcuff moving forward. He will be on bye in Week 5 before a Week 6 matchup against the Chargers.

news.body: Emmett Johnson rushed six times for 17 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Emmett Johnson sees six touches in Week 3
news.impact: Johnson has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield to begin the season, finishing with less than 25 rushing yards in each of the first three contests. The running back remains more of a handcuff option for Kenneth Walker owners ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders.

news.body: Jadarian Price rushed the ball ten times for 29 yards and caught two passes for eight yards in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price inefficient in loss Monday
news.impact: Price made his return to the lineup on Monday night after missing several games while on injured reserve. He didn't look great in his first game back, however, rushing at an inefficient clip of 2.9 yards per carry and not being much better in the passing game. He will not be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, especially with Zach Charbonnet also now back in the lineup for the Seahawks.

news.body: The Seahawks are expected to activate RB Jadarian Price from injured reserve for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) to be activated from IR Monday
news.impact: Price will return after a month-long absence. The Seahawks will have a fully healthy backfield for the first time this season between him and Zach Charbonnet.

news.body: Jadarian Price is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bears.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) off injury report Monday
news.impact: Price will make his return from injured reserve. Zach Charbonnet is also off the injury report, making it the first week all season the Seahawks backfield will be healthy.

news.body: Jadarian Price (chest) has officially been designated to return to practice for the Seahawks.
news.head: Jadarian Price (chest) designated to return to practice
news.impact: Price has spent some time on injured reserve while recovering from a chest issue, but the team has officially designated to return, opening up his 21-day practice window. He will be back sometime in the near future, which further complicates the distribution of work in a crowded Seattle backfield.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs carried the ball 23 times for 153 yards and one touchdown while also catching two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs shreds tough Vikings defense in Week 8 win
news.impact: Gibbs has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in four of his last five contests. The running back remains an explosive RB1 option entering a favorable Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs will play on Sunday against the Vikings.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) will play Sunday
news.impact: Gibbs is good to go despite missing practice to start the week on Wednesday. He will remain in his usual role for the Lions and fantasy managers.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs practiced on Thursday.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) practices Thursday
news.impact: Gibbs was not seen during the open portion of practice on Wednesday. His return on Thursday is a good sign for his status for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

news.body: Jahmyr Gibbs rushed the ball 29 times for 116 yards and caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jahmyr Gibbs racks up 143 yards in win Sunday
news.impact: Gibbs looked good on Sunday. He was a bit more inefficient than usual and failed to get into the end zone at all, but he still racked up 143 total yards on the day and ended with a great fantasy total. He is the best running back in fantasy right now and should continue to produce like it moving forward.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 80 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries in a 36-10 win over the Ravens. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 21 yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Cook found the end zone on a five-yard carry in the third quarter. Cook has a rushing touchdown in six straight games. Cook and the Bills have a tough matchup in Week 9 against a strong Vikings' defense.

news.body: James Cook III rushed the ball 22 times for 95 yards and a touchdown and caught three passes for 58 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: James Cook III plays well in win Sunday
news.impact: Cook played great on Sunday. He finished with over 150 total yards and a touchdown against the Raiders, which helped to lead the Bills to a big win on the road. He should continue to be a top-tier fantasy asset for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: James Cook III carried the ball 25 times for 111 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for a seven-yard gain in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: James Cook III rushes for two TDs in Week 5
news.impact: Cook fumbled twice, losing one, on Monday night, but he still managed to post a dominant fantasy outing. The veteran running back rushed for touchdowns of 17 and five yards in the contest. He now has 532 rushing yards and five touchdowns on the season. Cook will be a strong RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: James Cook III rushed for 75 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in the loss to the Patriots. He caught both of his targets for eight yards.
news.head: James Cook III finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Cook averaged 6.3 yards per carry on his 12 carries, providing the Bills with an incredibly efficient effort. Despite the strong performance, his 12 rushing attempts are a new season low. Cook and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 24 times for 56 yards while also catching one of his two targets for one yard in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Javonte Williams bottled up in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Williams was held in check out of the backfield, failing to reach the end zone for the first time in his last six contests. The running back will look to get back on track against a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: Javonte Williams rushed the ball 25 times for 155 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Javonte Williams sets career high in yards Monday
news.impact: Williams was absolutely dominant on Monday night. He set a new career high with 155 rushing yards over the course of the game, and he was also able to get into the end zone towards the end of the game, which was the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should be well pleased with his performance in this primetime matchup.

news.body: Javonte Williams carried the ball 11 times for 41 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for nine yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Javonte Williams finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Williams was held to a season-low 11 carries with the Cowboys falling behind 17-0 at halftime. The veteran still managed to find the end zone, giving him eight all-purpose scores through six games. He will remain a locked-in RB1 in fantasy heading into Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Javonte Williams ran 12 times for 45 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay. He also caught two of three targets for 17 yards.
news.head: Javonte Williams shut down in loss to Bucs
news.impact: Williams had some early success on Thursday, culminating in his early touchdown plunge on the Cowboys' first drive. However, he didn't get much going after that, as the Dallas offense stalled completely until the fourth quarter. He's not particularly efficient, but the volume is there, and he should be a viable RB2 most weeks.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 143 yards and a touchdown on 17 carries in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: Jaylen Warren runs for 143 yards Sunday
news.impact: Warren did not catch either of his two targets. He tied his career-high in rushing despite Rico Dowdle seeing 15 carries himself. Warren remains a borderline RB1/RB2 heading into the Steelers bye week.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Jaylen Warren goes off against Saints
news.impact: Warren was the clear lead back for the Steelers on Sunday, showing markedly better efficiency than fellow RB Rico Dowdle. A two-back system will still likely be employed to keep Warren fresh, but Warren is looking like a solid weekly RB1 candidate.

news.body: Jaylen Warren ran for 50 yards on 14 carries in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 2-of-4 targets for 28 yards receiving.
news.head: Jaylen Warren sees 16 touches Sunday
news.impact: Warren was the lead back in the Steelers backfield in the fourth quarter and overtime period over Rico Dowdle. He'll remain an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy labeled Jaylen Warren as the team's featured player when asked about the return of Rico Dowdle.
news.head: Jaylen Warren labeled 'featured player' by Steelers HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: Warren has continued to play very well in the absence of Dowdle. Even when Dowdle makes his return, Warren will remain a steady RB2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: The Cardinals placed RB Jeremiyah Love on injured reserve.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Love suffered a high-ankle sprain in Sunday's win over the Cowboys. He is expected to be sidelined for the next 4-5 weeks. Pending the status of Bam Knight, Tyler Allgeier will figure to return to the lead role in the Cardinals backfield.

news.body: Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur told reporters RB Jeremiyah Love has a new ankle injury.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love has new ankle injury
news.impact: Love will be further evaluated throughout the week.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is questionable to return for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) questionable to return Sunday
news.impact: Love suffered the apparent ankle injury in the second quarter, rushing nine times for 23 yards prior to exiting. Bam Knight and Tyler Allgeier will see increased touches out of the Arizona backfield in Love’s absence.

news.body: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play for the Arizona Cardinals Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will play Sunday

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed seven times for 13 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins held to 13 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't targeted and averaged 1.9 yards per carry. Meanwhile, Jonah Coleman had 15 touches for 104 total yards and scored the game-winning touchdown. Dobbins had scored in three straight games entering Sunday, but Coleman has led Denver's running backs in carries in both games since returning. The former is becoming touchdown-dependent.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed six times for 23 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins Finds End Zone in Week 7
news.impact: Dobbins scored from one yard out late in the third quarter, giving him a touchdown for the third consecutive game. The problem was everything else. His six carries were fewer than both Jonah Coleman's nine and Bo Nix's seven, while RJ Harvey remained involved in the passing game. Dobbins continues to find the end zone, but his workload took a significant hit with Coleman back. The former enters flex territory.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown in Denver's 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday. He also caught three passes for five yards.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins punches in touchdown in win
news.impact: Dobbins wasn't overly efficient in this game, with his long run of 16 yards meaning his other 16 carries went for 25 yards. Still, a touchdown and a few receptions can cover a multitude of sins. He's a volume-based RB3 moving forward.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins ran for 68 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries, adding six yards on two receptions in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: J.K. Dobbins finds the end zone in Week 5 win
news.impact: Dobbins scored his first touchdown of the season Sunday afternoon. The veteran back also set new season highs in touches and yards. Dobbins has not been very efficient this season, averaging just 3.6 yards on his nearly 13 carries per game, but he remains the workhorse in the Broncos' backfield. Dobbins has a tough matchup coming against the Seahawks in Week 6.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed 11 times for 41 yards and one touchdown, while catching four of five targets for 63 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jonah Coleman totals 104 yards, scores in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.

news.body: Jonah Coleman rushed nine times for 54 yards, while catching both of his targets for 15 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Jonah Coleman Totals 69 Yards in Return
news.impact: Coleman returned from injured reserve and immediately led Denver's running backs with nine carries, averaging six yards per attempt. J.K. Dobbins still received the goal-line touchdown, and RJ Harvey scored through the air, but Coleman's usage in his first game back is difficult to ignore. He's worth rostering as Denver sorts out what could become a three-man backfield. Coleman is worth a start next week for Zero RB drafters.

news.body: Jonah Coleman (ankle) is active for Week 7 for the Denver Broncos against the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jonah Coleman (ankle) active for Week 7
news.impact: Coleman will suit up after being activated earlier in the week from injured reserve, providing head coach Sean Payton with another option as part of a backfield including RJ Harvey and J.K. Dobbins against the Cardinals Sunday.

news.body: Jonah Coleman (ankle) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Jonah Coleman (ankle) logs another full practice Thursday
news.impact: The rookie seems to be geared up to play in Week 7, as he has logged two-straight full practices to start the week. He isn't likely to be a strong fantasy option in his first few games, but he should be involved enough to hurt the fantasy value of RJ Harvey for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor gained 23 yards on eight carries and 24 yards on four receptions in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor does little with a dozen touches in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Taylor opened this divisional matchup with a 19-yard run on the Colts' first play from scrimmage. After that, the star running back, who is surrounded by trade rumors, did very little. This one got out of hand early for the Colts, as they trailed 28-0 going into halftime. That led to fewer touches for Taylor and, easily, his weakest output of the season for fantasy managers.

news.body: The Colts are reportedly active in trade talks with teams around RB Jonathan Taylor.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor, Colts active in trade talks
news.impact: Tom Pelissero reported that the Colts already turned down an offer for Taylor that included a 2027 second-round pick and another pick. This will remain a situation to monitor with the trade deadline around the corner.

news.body: Colts head coach Shane Steichen said Jonathan Taylor has not requested a trade.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor has not requested a trade
news.impact: This report comes after Josh Downs requested a trade. The Colts already moved Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner in trades this week. It remains up in the air if Taylor will be traded.

news.body: Jonathan Taylor ran for 95 yards and a touchdown on 18 carries in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings. He also caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards receiving.
news.head: Jonathan Taylor finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Taylor opened up the scoring in what wound up being the lone touchdown scored on the day by the Colts. His name will remain one to monitor in trade rumors over the next couple of weeks.

news.body: Jordan Mason rushed eight times for 20 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 loss to the Lions in Week 8.
news.head: Jordan Mason bottled up in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Mason struggled to find running room in a losing effort, finishing with under 50 rushing yards for the first time in three contests. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 9 contest against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jordan Mason ran for 68 yards on 15 carries in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Mason leads Vikings backfield in return Sunday
news.impact: Mason did not start the game, but he was on the field more and saw more opportunity than Aaron Jones. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Lions.

news.body: Jordan Mason (thumb) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Mason seems to be trending the right direction for Week 7, as he was not limited in any way in his first official practice back on Wednesday. If he plays and has no workload restrictions this week, fantasy managers should consider starting him in a favorable matchup against the Colts.

news.body: Jordan Mason (thumb) is set to take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Mason (thumb) set to practice Wednesday
news.impact: Minnesota recently opened Mason's 21-day practice window, and he is expected to participate in Wednesday's practice to some capacity. It looks like he will have a good chance to make his return to the lineup this week, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor all updates about his health leading up to Week 7.

news.body: ESPN's Adam Schefter reports that multiple other women contacted police to detail their own allegations against Josh Jacobs.
news.head: Josh Jacobs: Additional accusers come forward
news.impact: Jacobs has played in two games since returning. It is unclear as of now if this will lead to anything for him. This will remain a situation to monitor.

news.body: Josh Jacobs rushed for 39 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries, adding in six catches for 13 yards and another touchdown during Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Josh Jacobs scores twice in Thursday night win
news.impact: Jacobs got a whopping 27 touches in a workhorse effort for the Packers on Thursday, but he only managed 52 total yards on them. He managed to score both on the ground and through the air, though, leaving fantasy managers happy if they went with him. The Packers have not been able to run the ball with any consistency this season, but Jacobs will get every opportunity to produce, it seems. He's best viewed as a TD-dependent RB2 in standard leagues.

news.body: Josh Jacobs rushed the ball 11 times for 36 yards and caught 5-of-7 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Josh Jacobs scores once in return game Sunday
news.impact: Sunday was the first game back for Jacobs after he missed the start of the season while on the Commissioner's Exempt List. He wasn't effective on the ground in his first game back, but he made his hay through the air with five catches, 55 yards, and a touchdown on the day. He should be a viable RB2 over the course of the back half of the season as he continues to knock the rust off after so much time off.

news.body: Josh Jacobs (suspension) is officially active for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Josh Jacobs (suspension) active for Week 7
news.impact: Jacobs will make his season debut after being placed on the commissioners exempt list in the summer, looking to boost a Green Bay ground attack that has struggled up until this point.

news.body: Kaelon Black rushed for 63 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Kaelon Black finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Black led the 49ers in carries Sunday afternoon and gashed the Falcons' defense for a 30-yard TD run in the second quarter. Christian McCaffrey did deal with a thigh issue in this one and ended up only outtouching Black 13-to-12. This was a nice game for Black, but he remains useful to fantasy managers only as a handcuff to McCaffrey.

news.body: Kaelon Black carried the ball eight times for 34 yards while catching his lone target for a three-yard gain in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Kaelon Black sees nine touches in MNF win
news.impact: Black looked good playing behind Christian McCaffrey, averaging 4.3 yards per carry for the 49ers. The rookie remains one of the top handcuffs in fantasy heading into a Week 7 matchup vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Kaelon Black ran for 16 yards on six carries in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: Kaelon Black sees six carries Sunday
news.impact: Black remains a pure stash for fantasy managers.

news.body: Kaelon Black is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
news.head: Kaelon Black (illness) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Black will remain a change-of-pace role alongside Christian McCaffrey.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed 21 times for 69 yards while catching four of five targets for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III totals 84 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Walker had 25 touches and accounted for 21 of Kansas City's 24 rushing attempts. That's the good. The bad? He averaged 3.3 yards per carry and failed to score. The workload is enough to keep Walker in fantasy lineups even when the production isn't there.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 14 times for 36 yards and caught four of his five targets for 21 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III held in check by Seahawks in Week 7
news.impact: Walker's 21 receiving yards were good enough for third on the Chiefs in receiving, which gives a good idea of how things went for the team's offense in the loss. The veteran running back has notched eight all-purpose touchdowns this season as the Chiefs' lead back. One of the top running backs in fantasy this season, Walker will be a locked-in RB1 in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III rushed 19 times for 128 yards and two touchdowns while catching two of three targets for 11 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III Runs for 128 Yards, Two TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Walker scored from 33 and two yards out while averaging 6.7 yards per carry. He also accounted for 19 of the Chiefs' 27 rushing attempts. There isn't much to question with that combination of workload and production. Walker remains a high-end RB1 going forward.

news.body: Kenneth Walker III carried the ball 22 times for 177 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for a two-yard gain in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Kenneth Walker III runs for 177 yards, two TDs in Week 4
news.impact: Walker notched his third multi-touchdown game of the season in what has been an impressive start to the year. The veteran running back found the end zone on rushes of two and 22 yards in the win. Overall, Walker has 537 rushing yards and six all-purpose touchdowns on the year. A locked-in high-end RB1 the rest of the way, he will be on bye in Week 5 before taking on the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell ran for 140 yards on 25 carries in the Buccaneers 16-0 win over the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell sees 25 carries Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell and Bucky Irving combined for 310 rushing yards on 52 carries on a day where Baker Mayfield did not complete a single pass. He'll be an RB3/RB4 play next week against the Bears.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell (hip) is officially active for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Brianna Dix.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) active for Week 8
news.impact: Gainwell will suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation, boosting a Tampa Bay backfield that will utilize both Gainwell and Bucky Irving against the Falcons Sunday.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: The Buccaneers did not have any elevations from their practice squad. Gainwell remains listed as questionable, but he will likely be available for Sunday.

news.body: Kenny Gainwell is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Falcons.
news.head: Kenny Gainwell (hip) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Gainwell returned to a limited practice on Thursday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball 16 times for 56 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Kyren Williams finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Williams contributed well on Sunday. He was able to churn out 56 yards and a touchdown on the ground, but he wasn't able to contribute much in the passing game, which hurt his fantasy total. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward, though the increasing involvement of Blake Corum isn't what fantasy managers want to see.

news.body: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 99 yards and one touchdown while also hauling in both of his targets for 22 yards in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads backfield in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, rushing for one or more touchdowns in three of his last four contests. The running back remains one of the more explosive offensive options as part of an injury-ravaged Rams offense for head coach Sean McVay, with a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Kyren Williams rushed the ball ten times for 50 yards and caught 3-of-6 targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Kyren Williams leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Williams saw 16 opportunities on Sunday, but he was a bit disappointing with them, racking up 67 yards without a touchdown in the team's loss to the Cardinals. After the game he voiced some frustrations about the timeshare the team currently has in the backfield, but fantasy managers shouldn't be too concerned about him moving forward and should continue to start him without reservation for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kyren Williams carried the ball 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching six of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Kyren Williams finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: Williams was mostly bottled up on the ground by the Buffalo defense on Monday night, but he still managed to punch in a one-yard TD run in the fourth quarter. The Rams' newfound willingness to use Williams in the passing attack this year has been an added bonus as he already has 27 catches through five games, putting him just nine grabs shy of setting a new career-high. Williams will be a locked-in RB1 in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed for 83 yards on 25 carries in a 38-33 win over the Jets.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. sees 25 rushing attempts in Week 8 win
news.impact: Washington saw 25 carries to Ashton Jeanty's two rushing attempts in the win. Head coach Klint Kubiak stated after the game that the reduced workload for Jeanty was by design. Fantasy managers should expect Washington to continue to be involved in the running game heading into Week 9 against the 49ers.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. rushed six times for a team-high 27 yards while also failing to catch his only target in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. leads quiet backfield in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Washington Jr. has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, rushing for less than 50 yards in each of his last four contests. The running back remains more of a valuable handcuff option for Ashton Jeanty owners ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is active for Week 7 for the Las Vegas Raiders against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) active for Week 7
news.impact: Washington Jr. is good to go after clearing through pregame testing without any issues, boosting a Las Vegas backfield as a complementary option behind bellcow Ashton Jeanty against the Rams Sunday.

news.body: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Washington missed Thursday's practice due to a pair of injuries that he's dealing with, but HC Klint Kubiak told reporters that he expects the young running back to play on Sunday, though the team will give him a pregame evaluation to ensure that he's healthy enough to suit up. Assuming he's active, he will continue to be an involved RB2 on this offense behind Ashton Jeanty, though he doesn't project to have much fantasy value in this particular matchup.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II ran 19 times for 69 yards in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots. He also failed to catch his only target.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II runs for 69 yards in loss
news.impact: After four straight weeks with a rushing touchdown and three straight weeks of 88+ rushing yards, Gordon finally had himself a down game. That's to be expected for a player who has almost zero passing game involvement; the floor falls out when receiving is nil. He will face off against the Lions next weekend.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed for 103 yards and a touchdown on 23 carries in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He caught 1-of-3 targets for no yards.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Gordon has scored in four straight games and tallied 80+ rushing yards in three straight contests. Jaylen Wright exited the game with a quad injury, which could to Gordon seeing plenty of work again in Week 8 if Wright is unable to play against New England.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball 18 times for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gordon was Miami's leading rusher on Sunday, finishing with 88 yards and a touchdown while maintaining an efficient clip of 4.9 yards per carry. He saw no opportunities in the receiving game, however, which severely hindered his upside. That will be a problem for his week-to-week consistency moving forward if the team makes no efforts to get him involved as a receiver.

news.body: Ollie Gordon II rushed the ball nine times for 100 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 15-10 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Ollie Gordon II plays well in loss Sunday
news.impact: Gordon was one of the only bright spots for Miami's offense this week. He finished with 100 yards and a touchdown on just nine carries, which left him with a great efficiency number in this game. He has clearly separated himself from Jaylen Wright in terms of talent and output, but they continue to be somewhat close together in terms of opportunities, which could limit Gordon moving forward.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed the ball nine times for 20 yards and caught two passes for seven yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Omarion Hampton disappoints again in loss Sunday
news.impact: Hampton hasn't been able to get anything going over the course of the season, and Sunday was no exception. He totaled just 27 yards on his 11 touches and wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He should not be started in nearly any league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Omarion Hampton rushed seven times for 18 yards while catching all four of his targets for 21 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.
news.head: Omarion Hampton Totals 39 Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Hampton averaged just 2.6 yards per carry, but the bigger concern is the workload. Kimani Vidal also received seven carries and finished with seven touches compared to Hampton's 11. The four receptions helped Hampton in PPR formats, but a split backfield on an 0-6 offense isn't an ideal fantasy situation.

news.body: Omarion Hampton gained only 33 yards on 14 carries, adding a six-yard reception during Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Omarion Hampton held under 40 yards on 15 touches
news.impact: Much to the chagrin of fantasy managers, Hampton continues to share the backfield load with Kimani Vidal and Keaton Mitchell. Hampton had at least found the end zone in three of the first four weeks, but he failed to do so in Week 5. The second-year back is averaging only 3.7 yards on his nearly 15 carries per game, and he's basically become an afterthought in the Chargers' passing attack.

news.body: Omarion Hampton ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on nine carries in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for eight yards receiving.
news.head: Omarion Hampton finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Hampton saw just nine carries to 15 combined carries between Keaton Mitchell and Kimani Vidal. Hampton is a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins ran for 25 yards on 11 carries in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers. He also caught 2-of-2 targets for 24 yards receiving.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins shut down on ground Sunday
news.impact: Judkins was completely stifled on the ground all afternoon. He will look to bounce back as an RB2 play next week against the Saints.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins carried the ball 17 times for 96 yards and two touchdowns while catching his lone target for an eight-yard gain in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins scores twice in Week 7 win
news.impact: Judkins turned in one of his better games as a pro, finding the end zone on runs of five and six yards in the win. He looked good after missing the previous week with an ankle injury. Judkins now has three rushing touchdowns across six contests this season. He will be on the RB2 radar in Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 7 for the Cleveland Browns according to Mary Kay Cabot.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) off injury report for Week 7
news.impact: Judkins is good to go after increasing reps in practice throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken, setting the running back up to lead a Cleveland backfield that could be missing Dylan Sampson (knee) against the Titans Sunday.

news.body: Quinshon Judkins practiced on Thursday.
news.head: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Judkins is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Titans. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball 11 times for 55 yards and a touchdown while catching two of his three targets for five yards in a 27-10 win over the Eagles in Week 8.
news.head: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: White found the end zone for the second straight game as he punched in a one-yard score to put the game out of reach with 1:52 left in regulation. White has been a solid fantasy running back while leading the Washington backfield with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve and should continue to be in fantasy lineups in Week 9 vs. the Rams.

news.body: Rachaad White carried the ball seven times for 27 yards and caught four of his five targets for 30 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Rachaad White finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: White had a larger role than usual with Jacory Croskey-Merritt on injured reserve with a groin injury. White took advantage, leading the Washington backfield in touches while scoring on a nine-yard pass from Jayden Daniels in the fourth quarter. White is looking like a high-end RB3 in fantasy going forward as he heads into his bye in Week 7.

news.body: Rachaad White was wearing a non-contact jersey in practice on Friday.
news.head: Rachaad White (shoulder) in non-contact jersey in practice
news.impact: White was listed as a full participant in practice on Thursday. He'll need to be monitored to see if he gets downgraded on Friday.

news.body: Rachaad White (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Rachaad White (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
