news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

news.body: Chris Olave is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Olave returned to practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.body: Christian Watson (rib) was limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Watson suffered a rib injury in Green Bay's win over the Panthers last week, which left him limited at the team's practice on Wednesday. It looks like he's on track to be a full go for Week 9, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Christian Watson is practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (rib) practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Watson left last Thursday’s game early before eventually returning later in the game. He is on track to be good to go this week.

news.body: Christian Watson hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 113 yards in Thursday night's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Christian Watson deals with rib injury, eclipses 100 yards in Week 8
news.impact: Watson's performance was impressive enough without considering that he reportedly broke a rib, went to the hospital, and still returned before the end of the game. Adding all that into the equation, this was nothing short of a Herculean effort. Watson led the Pack in receptions and yards, recording a new season-high in the former column. The fifth-year pro is finally putting together the type of breakout campaign many have been waiting for, and he'll have a couple extra days to try to heal up before Week 9's game in New England.

news.body: Christian Watson has returned to the game against the Panthers and received a target immediately.
news.head: Christian Watson returns to game against Panthers
news.impact: Watson went to the hospital to be checked for an injury, and is now back in the game. He will look to build on his big game against Carolina.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught one pass for seven yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Cooper Kupp finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Kupp was able to catch a touchdown on Monday night, but that was his only reception, so he still had a terrible fantasy total over the course of the game. He remains entirely off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 20 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Kupp was quiet just one week after drawing 10 targets vs. the Broncos. The veteran wideout continues to operate as Seattle's No. 2 receiver, although the majority of the work goes to Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Kupp will be a low-end flex option in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught five of ten targets for 50 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 50 yards in loss
news.impact: Kupp had arguably his best game of the season, with season-highs in targets, receptions, and yards, lacking only a touchdown. He is a bit of a risky start most weeks, as his volume has been low for the most part. A near 20% target share this week is a nice sign of life, but we will need to see more consistency to really feel comfortable starting him.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp part of crazy ending Sunday
news.impact: On 4th-and-10 with the game on the line, Kupp caught an 8-yard pass, made one defender miss and dove for the first down. After review, he wound up being short by one yard. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught all four of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Courtland Sutton records 53 receiving yards in Week 8
news.impact: Sutton's 53 yards were his most since Week 2. That's the good. The bad? He saw only four targets and has now gone seven straight games without a touchdown. One improved performance doesn't change what Sutton has been through eight weeks. He remains difficult to start outside of deeper leagues.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches two passes in win
news.impact: Sutton was quiet in this game, though there wasn't much to go around when the team combined for 107 passing yards. It's been a rough start to the year for QB Bo Nix, and until he improves, the pass catchers will suffer.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught 2-of-3 targets for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches first touchdown of the season
news.impact: Sutton found the end zone for the first time this season during Sunday's win, but the veteran receiver still hasn't really gotten going. Sutton has finished with three or fewer receptions in all five weeks so far. He's also topped out at 46 yards. Sutton cannot be relied upon for much fantasy production in the Broncos' lackluster passing attack right now.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Davante Adams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Davante Adams off injury report Monday
news.impact: Adams received a rest day in practice during the week. He'll remain a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught all three of his targets for 76 yards and a score in the Patriots' 24-19 win over Miami on Sunday.
news.head: DeMario Douglas leads Patriots WRs in win
news.impact: Douglas led the Patriots in receiving yards and tied for third on the team in targets with two other players: Hunter Henry and Rhamondre Stevenson. Douglas made his targets count, though, with a 48 yard score being the highlight of his night. Should AJ Brown continue to miss time, Douglas seems to be a safe bet for targets and production.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards and two touchdowns in the Patriots win over Las Vegas.
news.head: DeMario Douglas hits pay dirt twice in Week 5 win
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on receptions of eight and 35-yards, accounting for his first scores of the season. Douglas has an opportunity to become a key component of the offense with AJ Brown and Mack Hollins on injured reserve. Douglas and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Denzel Boston (calf) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (calf) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie was a limited participant on Wednesday. He's managing a calf issue right now, but it doesn't seem to be serious enough to threaten his availability for Week 9. If active on Sunday, his target share may look different with Shedeur Sanders set to be the starting quarterback for the Browns.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught 6-of-11 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Denzel Boston hauls in six passes Sunday
news.impact: Boston was second only behind Harold Fannin on the team in targets. He was unable to turn any of them into big gains. He remains on the WR3/WR4 radar for fantasy managers as a volatile week-to-week play.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught three of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Denzel Boston catches three balls in Week 7
news.impact: Boston drew a healthy eight targets but he wasn't able to do much with the opportunities while fellow rookie KC Concepcion posted a career day with eight catches for 129 yards. Boston now has 20 catches for 372 yards and three touchdowns in seven games this year. He will be a flex option in Week 8 against the Steelers.

news.body: Denzel Boston (foot) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (foot) limited Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie is still dealing with a nagging foot issue and was limited for another practice on Wednesday as a result. He was able to play through it last week, however, so he is expected to do the same again in Week 7 unless he suffers a setback at practice this week.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Devaughn Vele totals 42 yards Sunday
news.impact: Vele was the second-leading receiver on the day for New Orleans. He is a borderline flex play in games where the passing volume is low for the Saints.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught four of his six targets for 26 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Devaughn Vele bottled up in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Vele has made an inconsistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout will look to get back on track for head coach Kellen Moore in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 6-of-9 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Devaughn Vele finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Vele's strong start to the season continued on Monday night. He caught six passes for 54 yards over the course of the game, one of which he was able to take to the house for a touchdown. He will continue to have solid week-to-week upside until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is back in the lineup for the Saints.

news.body: DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Smith will miss another game for the Eagles alongside Dontayvion Wicks. They both remain week-to-week.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not practicing for the Philadelphia Eagles Friday according to Jimmy Kempski.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
news.impact: Smith has yet to take the practice field for head coach Nick Sirianni, leaving the wideout’s status question entering the weekend.

news.body: DeVonta Smith was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not seen practicing Thursday
news.impact: Smith did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday off a short week.

news.body: DeVonta Smith did not participate in Wednesday’s walkthrough practice.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses walkthrough Wednesday
news.impact: Smith was sidelined in Week 7 against the Cowboys. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: DJ Moore caught 4-of-7 targets for 82 yards and a touchdown in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore hauls in TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Moore found the end zone on an 11-yard reception early in the fourth quarter. Moore did indicate after the game that he was fine after leaving the game late with a knee injury. Moore and the Bills take on the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is officially active for Week 8 for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) active for Week 8
news.impact: Moore is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, boosting a Buffalo passing attack for quarterback Josh Allen against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is expected to play for the Buffalo Bills against the Baltimore Ravens according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Moore looks poised to return from a two-game absence barring any pregame setbacks, offering quarterback Josh Allen an impactful pass-catching option against the Ravens Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore was listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Ravens.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Moore has been limited in practice throughout the week. He should have a good chance of returning off the bye week. He'll be a WR2 play in a potential shootout.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 1-of-6 targets for four yards in the Steelers 27-6 win over the Browns.
news.head: DK Metcalf drops pass that leads to interception Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf dropped an open pass that was going for over 30 yards. He not only dropped the pass, but the ball also bounced off him and resulted in an interception. He is an upside WR3 with a low floor for fantasy managers.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught two of six targets for 56 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in big 51 yarder in win
news.impact: Metcalf has been very up and down this season, with a big 115 yard performance against Cleveland followed up by 12 yards the following week, then an 11-for-93 stat line last Sunday, and finally two for 56 this Sunday. He's a boom-bust receiver for now; if you can afford to let him have his ups and downs, then he's a fine start. But more than likely, he's a risky flex at best.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

news.body: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

news.body: Drake London caught 1-of-6 targets for eight yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Drake London catches one pass Sunday
news.impact: It was a week to forget for the entire Falcons offense as Michael Penix Jr. completed just eight passes all day and threw four interceptions. London remains a WR1 play next week against the Bengals.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Drake London hauled in four of his team-leading 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Drake London sees 10 targets in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: London continues to make the most of his role as the primary option in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack, registering 10 or more targets in three of the last four contests. The wideout will look to make a more explosive impact in a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Drake London eclipses 100 yards in Sunday's loss
news.impact: London went over 100 yards for the second time in three weeks Sunday night, and he only missed the mark by four yards in Week 4. Surprisingly, London has still yet to find the end zone on any of his 27 grabs this season. London has looked nothing less than a WR1 with Michael Penix at QB for the Falcons. Unfortunately, Penix (ribs) is now dealing with another injury.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught all five of his targets for 37 yards in the Patriots' 24-19 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Efton Chism III snags five passes in win
news.impact: Chism led the Patriots in targets and receptions in this game, posting a modest 37-yard total as a result. He could be back in as a sneaky PPR flex should AJ Brown continue to miss time, but his floor and ceiling seem to be fairly low at this point in time.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 5-of-6 targets for 57 yards in the Patriots win over the Raiders. He added two rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Efton Chism III hauls in five passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Chism led the team in targets with six, setting an new season high in targets, yards, and receptions. With Mack Hollins and AJ Brown on injured reserve, Chism appears to be carving out a role in the offense.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 17
news.impact: Chism caught a 10-yard pass for a touchdown in the third quarter, accounting for his first career score. The Patriots were depleted at wide receiver, giving Chism an opportunity to play on offense. The rookie will look to build on this performance in Week 18 against Miami.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka was not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Egbuka cleared concussion protocol last week, but he was still ruled out for a foot/ankle injury. His status for Week 9 is uncertain.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (ankle/concussion) has been ruled out for Week 8 for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (ankle/concussion) ruled out for Week 8
news.impact: Egbuka was unable to take the practice field throughout the week and will now miss the Week 8 contest, leaving the Tampa Bay passing attack without its primary option against the

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) is sitting out Friday's practice session.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) not practicing Friday
news.impact: After being a limited participant on Thursday, Egbuka was not active during the morning practice session for the Buccaneers on Friday. It certainly looks like he will be a no-go once again in Week 8. Chris Godwin, Tez Johnson, and Ted Hurst III will be the main wide-receiver group for QB Bake Mayfield.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) limited participant Thursday
news.impact: Egbuka was limited again on Thursday as he continues to deal with a pair of injuries. He was able to shed his red non-contact jersey, however, which indicates that he is progressing well at this point. Friday's injury report should give us more clarity on whether or not he will be ready to go in time for Week 8.

news.body: Garrett Wilson (concussion) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Garrett Wilson (concussion) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Wilson was recently placed in the NFL's concussion protocols and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. It looks like a long shot that he will be cleared to play in time for Sunday's game, and if he's ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. should both see a substantial increase in opportunities in his absence.

news.body: The Jets placed WR Garrett Wilson in concussion protocol.
news.head: Garrett Wilson placed in concussion protocol
news.impact: Wilson sustained a head injury in Week 8 against the Raiders. His status for this week is all of a sudden up in the air. If he is ruled out, Adonai Mitchell and Omar Cooper Jr. could both step into bigger roles.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught 6-of-12 targets for 83 yards in a 38-33 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Garrett Wilson hauls in six passes in Week 8
news.impact: Wilson led the team in targets and was second on the team in receptions and receiving yards. This marked his second highest target total of the season, which he needed after being targeted just three times last week. Wilson and the Jets will travel to Kansas City in Week 9.

news.body: The Jets are currently not expected to trade WR Garrett Wilson.
news.head: Garrett Wilson not expected to be traded
news.impact: Wilson told reporters this week that he hasn’t requested a trade. It appears the Jets will continue to build around him.

news.body: George Pickens was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: George Pickens limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Pickens is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts. He'll remain a volatile WR2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: George Pickens caught two of his four targets for 48 yards in the Cowboys' 33-30 Week 8 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: George Pickens quiet in Week 8 loss to Cardinals
news.impact: Pickens has fallen back to earth of late, finishing under 60 receiving yards in each of his last two contests. The wideout will look to take advantage of a generous Indianapolis Colts defense in Week 9.

news.body: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is officially active for Week 8 for the Dallas Cowboys against the Arizona Cardinals according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) active for Week 8
news.impact: Pickens is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation for head coach Brian Schottenheimer, boosting a Dallas passing offense that will look to feast on the Cardinals defense Sunday.

news.body: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) is expected to play for the Dallas Cowboys against the Arizona Cardinals according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: George Pickens (shoulder/hamstring) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Pickens looks poised to take the field barring any pregame setbacks for head coach Brian Schottenheimer, boosting a Dallas passing attack that will look to move the ball with ease against the Cardinals Sunday.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-5 targsts for 95 yards in the Falcons 16-0 loss against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson hauls in 76 yard pass Sunday
news.impact: Dotson had a 76-yard reception with the Falcons recording 224 total yards of offense as a team. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 1-of-3 targets for only six yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson catches one short pass in Sunday's win
news.impact: Dotson has become a big-play wideout for the Falcons, as he had averaged nearly 28 yards on his seven total grabs over the previous three weeks headed into Sunday's game. He had also found the end zone twice in that stretch. However, as should be expected going forward, Dotson showed in this contest that he is a boom-or-bust fantasy option in the Falcons' passing attack.

news.body: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his five targets for 87 yards and one touchdown in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finds end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Dotson has made the most of his opportunities in the Atlanta passing offense of late, finishing with over 50 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout will look to offer head coach another stable pass-catching option moving forward, with a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finishes with 54 receiving yards in Week 5
news.impact: Dotson made a couple of big grabs in Sunday's game, but he remained no higher than the fourth option in the Falcons' passing attack. Dotson is averaging 18.6 yards per reception and caught his only touchdown so far this season in Week 4. That TD came off the arm of Michael Penix, who is now dealing with a rib injury.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is off of the injury report for Thursday night's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) off injury report for Thursday
news.impact: Meyers has been dealing with a pair of injuries lately, but neither of them are serious and he will be good to go for Thursday night's game. He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy option on a week-to-week basis even if active, however.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers was limited in practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Meyers is on track to be good to go. He'll remain a fringe WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers finishes with a pair of receptions in Week 8
news.impact: Meyers actually led the Jaguars in targets on Sunday, as Trevor Lawrence and backup Quinn Ewers only put the ball in the air a combined 17 times. The Jaguars just did not need to sling it around to vanquish the Colts. Meyers has now caught two or fewer passes in 4-of-7 games so far this season, but he's still a significant piece of a high-powered offense.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) is active for Week 8 for the Jacksonville Jaguars according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) active for Week 8
news.impact: Meyers will take the field after not suffering any setbacks during pregame warmups for head coach Liam Cohen, offering quarterback Trevor Lawrence another impactful pass-catcher Sunday.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just 2-of-5 targets for 36 yards, but scored a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 loss to the Packers.
news.head: Jalen Coker hits paydirt in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Unfortunately for fantasy managers, Coker was hit with a lost fumble on an errant lateral attempt during the Panthers' last-ditch play of regulation. Still, Coker salvaged what could've been a second straight frustrating performance with a 26-yard TD play in the fourth quarter. The third-year wideout has been inconsistent on a weekly basis to this point, but he's got significant upside each time he takes the field. He's a WR3 in most standard formats.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker caught six passes for 97 yards while seeing a season-high 13 targets in Week 6.
news.head: Jalen Coker has game-high 97 yards vs. Eagles
news.impact: Coker has at least nine targets in every game he has finished this season, forming an impressive tandem with second-year star Tetairoa McMillan. He had two touchdowns in Week 1 and has not scored since, but Carolina's passing attack has been impressive, and more will come in the future.

news.body: Jalen Coker (quad) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Coker (quad) practices in full again Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Coker was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. He's expected to be close to full health for Sunday's game against the Eagles, in which case fantasy managers can feel comfortable starting him in that matchup.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 11 of his 16 targets for 141 yards and a touchdown in a 43-36 overtime win over the Titans in Week 8.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase goes for 141 yards, TD in Week 8 win
news.impact: Chase turned in a huge game in the high-scoring win, although he still finished behind Tee Higgins in receiving yardage on an afternoon where Joe Burrow threw for 462 yards. Chase has scored a touchdown in three straight games, giving him six overall this year. He will be a no-brainer WR1 in fantasy heading into Week 9 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 8 for the Cincinnati Bengals according to Paul Dehner Jr.
news.head: Ja’Marr Chase (ankle) off injury report for Week 8
news.impact: Chase is good to go after battling ankle issues earlier in the week, boosting a Cincinnati passing attack for Week 8.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase was seen in uniform for practice on Thursday.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase (ankle) in uniform for practice Thursday
news.impact: Chase missed practice to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll need to continue to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: Ja’Marr Chase’s ankle injury “is not considered a major deal.”
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase not believed to be dealing with serious ankle injury
news.impact: Chase missed practice on Wednesday with the ankle injury. He'll need to continue to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: Jameson Williams hauled in four of his six targets for a team-high 70 yards and one touchdown in the Lions' 19-15 Week 8 win over the Vikings.
news.head: Jameson Williams finds end zone in Week 8 win over Vikings
news.impact: Williams has had a nose for the end zone of late, registering one or more receiving touchdowns in each of his last three games. The wideout remains one of the more explosive offensive options for head coach Dan Campbell entering a juicy Week 9 matchup against the Miami Dolphins.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: The Lions gave Williams plenty of opportunities on Sunday, and he was able to capitalize on them. He caught two touchdowns and came close to hitting the 100 receiving yards mark, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He should continue to be viewed as a high-ceiling fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though his floor leaves something to be desired.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Williams only caught two passes on Sunday, but he was able to get into the end zone on both of them, which left him with a great fantasy total in this win over the Cardinals. He is expected to continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: Jameson Williams came up with 6-of-8 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jameson Williams clears 100 yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: After being held under 50 yards and no more than four grabs over the first three weeks of the season, Williams finally got going Sunday night. The big-play blazer had a long gain of 49 yards and averaged 17 yards on his half-dozen receptions. Williams should be viewed as an upside WR3 heading into Week 5.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauled in 6-of-11 targets for 118 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba stellar in loss Monday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba was by far Seattle's leading receiver on Monday night, finishing with 92 more yards than their second highest contributor. He was also able to get into the end zone again and finished with a terrific fantasy total, which just adds to the insane pace that he has established over the first half of the season.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine of his 12 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauls in TD in Week 7 win
news.impact: Smith-Njigba's crazy production continues as he has at least 100 receiving yards in all but one of his seven games this season while adding eight touchdowns along the way. The star wideout will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Bears on Monday night.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues crazy start to season in loss to Denver
news.impact: JSN had himself a night against the Broncos' defense, though he got off to a quiet start. He has 717 yards through six games, a blistering pace of 2,031 receiving yards. He had almost 1,800 receiving yards last year, and if he can match or exceed that in 2026, it would be truly incredible.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was upgraded to a full practice on Wednesday and has no injury designation for Thursday night.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba practices in full Wednesday, no injury designation
news.impact: JSN was initially listed as limited due to an ankle injury, but it looks like he will be a full go against Denver. Lock him into starting lineups.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught three of six targets for 39 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 28-24 win over the Chiefs in Week 8.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle scores touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Waddle scored from one yard out in the second quarter and caught the two-point conversion that cut Kansas City's lead to three in the fourth quarter. He also led Denver's wide receivers with six targets. The yardage wasn't there, but Waddle has separated himself from Courtland Sutton and Marvin Mims Jr. as the Broncos wide receiver to start in fantasy.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (chest) is officially active for Week 8 for the Denver Broncos against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (chest) active for Week 8
news.impact: Waddle is good to go after clearing through pregame activities without any setbacks for head coach Sean Payton, as the wideout will look to get back on track against a shorthanded Kansas City secondary.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (chest) is expected to play for the Denver Broncos against the Kansas City Chiefs according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (chest) expected to play Sunday
news.impact: Waddle looks good to go barring any pregame issues for head coach Sean Payton, offering an inconsistent Denver offense another option against a shorthanded Kansas City secondary Sunday.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Chiefs.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (chest) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Waddle got in a pair of limited practices to end the week. He will be a borderline WR2/WR3 play for fantasy managers if he is cleared.

news.body: Jordan Addison hauled in three of his eight targets for 66 yards in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Jordan Addison leads pass-catchers in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Addison has battled inconsistent involvement in the Minnesota passing attack, finishing with under 70 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Addison quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a low volume day for the entire Vikings passing attack. Addison remains a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) was officially a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) officially a full participant Wednesday
news.impact: Addison seems to be close to full health again after Minnesota's bye week last week. He was a full participant at practice on Wednesday and should be a full go for Week 7, although he doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future if Justin Jefferson (ankle) is in the lineup.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) will take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) will practice Wednesday
news.impact: Addison is going to be at practice on Wednesday after missing Week 5's game with a hamstring issue. He has had a bye week in between to heal, so he may be fully healthy for Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 4-of-5 targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Josh Downs finds the end zone in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Downs was the only Colts player to get into the end zone Sunday, scoring his first touchdown of the season on a six-yard pass from Daniel Jones late in the third quarter. Overall, Downs has mostly been a disappointment for fantasy managers this season. He has caught four or fewer passes in each of the last five games without reaching 50 yards in any of them.

news.body: Josh Downs will play for the Colts on Sunday against the Jaguars.
news.head: Josh Downs will play for Colts Sunday
news.impact: This comes after Downs reportedly requested a trade this week. He'll remain a borderline flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Josh Downs has requested a trade from the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Josh Downs requests trade from Indianapolis
news.impact: Downs has been unsatisfied with his current role and is in a contract year. Spending that year on a team heading nowehere fast is not ideal, so trying to land on a team where you can build up your value and or get paid is the right idea. Now it’s just seeing whether or not he will be dealt, and where.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 2-of-4 targets for 18 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Josh Downs sees team-high four targets Sunday
news.impact: Downs led the team in targets, while Keenan Allen led the team with just 31 receiving yards. Downs remains on the border of being a WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in five of his nine targets for 33 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 19-15 Week 8 loss to the Lions.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 8 loss to Lions
news.impact: Jefferson made the most of an otherwise forgettable performance, scoring a touchdown for the second time in four contests despite recording less than 45 receiving yards in three of his last four contests. The wideout has fallen victim to underwhelming quarterback play to this point ahead of a Week 9 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Justin Jefferson caught 4-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Justin Jefferson quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a quiet afternoon for the entire Vikings passing attack. Jefferson will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Lions.

news.body: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The Vikings chose to limit Jefferson's workload at practice on Wednesday, though he is likely close to full health after the team's bye week last week. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 7, barring something unforeseen.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in six of his seven targets for a team-leading 79 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 5 win over Saints
news.impact: Jefferson has offered mixed results in the Minnesota passing attack to begin the season, reaching the end zone in two of his four contests. The wideout enters the Week 6 bye as one of many inconsistent offensive options for head coach Kevin O'Connell.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 37 yards in the Browns 27-6 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. totals 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Concepcion was quiet compared to last week when he exploded for 129 yards. He'll remain a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught eight of his 10 targets for 129 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for eight catches, 129 yards in Week 7
news.impact: The rookie easily turned in his best game as a pro as he dominated the Titans in the close win. Concepcion came into the game with just 186 receiving yards on the year and came close to doubling that total while leading the Browns in all receiving categories against Tennessee. He will be a WR3 heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie is currently dealing with a pair of injuries and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. They could affect his availability or workload for Week 7, but we won't know more until later on in the week.

news.body: Cleveland Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion Jr. caught four passes for 37 yards in the team's Week 6 win against Baltimore.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. catches four passes in Week 6
news.impact: Concepcion caught at least four passes for the fourth time in six weeks to open his career. He has been steadily involved in Cleveland's offense, earning five or more targets in all but one week, though he has only exceeded 50 yards once. A big week could be coming soon for the Browns' dynamic receiver, as the team has prioritized giving him touches.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught all seven of his targets for 67 yards in Sunday's 42-7 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Keenan Allen grabs seven passes in Sunday's loss
news.impact: Allen led all players in this contest in receptions and receiving yards, as the 34-year-old veteran continues to show he can still make plays. Allen has averaged just shy of six grabs and 60 yards over his last five games, but with trade rumors swirling around the Colts, his situation may soon change.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught 3-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: It was a low-volume passing day for the Colts offense as Allen led the team in receiving. He remains a low upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Keenan Allen (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
news.head: Keenan Allen (rest) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Allen was back at practice on Thursday after getting the day off on Wednesday. He was a full participant and should be fully good to go for Week 7's matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Keenan Allen (rest) was sidelined at Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Keenan Allen (rest) sidelined at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was held out of Wednesday's practice, which was to be expected, since the Colts have made a habit out of giving him at least one day off per week. He should be good to go for Week 7.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Keon Coleman held to one reception in Week 8
news.impact: Coleman saw a major drop off from his six targets last week. With his inconsistent usage this season, fantasy managers should look elsewhere against the Vikings in Week 9.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 4-of-6 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Keon Coleman leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Coleman stepped up with DJ Moore (shoulder) sidelined for the Bills on Sunday. He led the team with 59 receiving yards against the Raiders, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a nice fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started in most league formats if Moore has to miss additional time beyond this game.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard touchdown in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Keon Coleman catches TD in Week 5
news.impact: Coleman made his only catch count as he hauled in Josh Allen's lone touchdown pass late in the third quarter. It was still a disappointing game for Coleman, who was expected to see a larger target share with DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive. Coleman will be on the flex radar in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Raiders if Moore isn't ready to return to the field.

news.body: Keon Coleman (ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Keon Coleman (ankle) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: Coleman was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday. His ankle injury seems to be a non-issue, so fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his health moving forward. He will be primed for a large workload again this week if DJ Moore (shoulder) is unable to play against the Rams.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 5-of-6 targets for 64 yards in a 36-10 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in five passes in Week 8 win
news.impact: Shakir has seen back-to-back games with at least six targets and has logged at least four receptions in each of those games. Shakir and the Bills will take on a tough Vikings' defense in Week 9.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Khalil Shakir finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Shakir was a bit disappointing as far as yardage goes on Sunday, but he made up for that by scoring one of Buffalo's touchdowns through the air. Still, he isn't a reliable fantasy option at this point, and fantasy managers should be especially wary about starting him whenever DJ Moore (shoulder) is back in the lineup for Buffalo.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught all three of his targets for 80 yards in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Khalil Shakir goes for 80 yards in Week 5 win
news.impact: Shakir led the Bills in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 57-yard catch early in overtime. Shakir now has 18 catches for 256 yards and no touchdowns through his team's first five games. He will be a flex option in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 7-of-8 targets for 82 yards in the Bills loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in seven passes in Week 4
news.impact: Shakir led the team in receptions and targets in the loss Sunday. All three marks are new season highs for Shakir, a potential positive sign for fantasy managers that have rostered him in a tough season. Shakir and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Ladd McConkey caught 4-of-5 targets for 86 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Ladd McConkey leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McConkey had a solid game on the stat sheet on Sunday, leading the team with 84 yards in a loss to the Rams. That was heavily propped up by a 50+ yard catch he had on a tipped deep shot at the end of the first half, however, so he wasn't actually a consistent contributor throughout the course of the game. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high trust in starting him on a weekly basis, especially with how bad this offense still looks for the Chargers.

news.body: Ladd McConkey is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Rams.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: McConkey has been able to clear the concussion protocol. It has been a rough season injury wise for him. He remains a WR2 when he is healthy.

news.body: Ladd McConkey taken out of Sunday's game early due to a concussion.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (concussion) knocked out of Sunday's game
news.impact: The setbacks just continue for McConkey this season. He worked through a foot injury at practice this week. Now, he'll enter the league's concussion protocol after exiting Sunday's game against the Chiefs in the second quarter. McConkey made just one reception for 17 yards prior to leaving.

news.body: Ladd McConkey (foot) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: McConkey wasn't able to play much last week due to his foot injury, but he seems to be mostly over it at this point, as he is off of the injury report and good to go heading into the weekend. He will almost certainly be Los Angeles' top target in this game, but it's hard to trust starting him at this point with how bad Los Angeles' offense has looked through the first five games of the season.

news.body: Luther Burden III caught 7-of-9 targets for 56 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Luther Burden III finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Burden looked great on Monday night. He caught seven passes over the course of the game and was able to get into the end zone on one of them, which left him with a good fantasy total. He has been heating up lately and should be started in all league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Luther Burden III caught all four of his targets for 130 yards and a touchdown, adding a seven-yard run in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Luther Burden III shows off big-play skills Thursday night
news.impact: Burden and QB Caleb Williams have certainly been on the same page since the latter returned from injury in Week 6. Over the last two games, Burden has come up with all 12 of his targets for a combined 225 yards. The second-year receiver gained a season-high 130 yards on Thursday night, recording the third 100-yard effort of his career. Burden is solidifying himself in the WR2 range for standard fantasy leagues.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Luther Burden III leads pass-catchers in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Burden III has made the most of increased involvement in the passing attack of late, finishing with four or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of many pass-catching options that have flashed impactful ability for head coach Ben Johnson, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in four of his six targets for a team-leading 47 yards while also rushing four times for two yards in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Luther Burden III leads underwhelming passing offense in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Burden III has seen consistent involvement in the Chicago passing attack to begin the season, recording four or more receptions in four of five contests. The wideout remains one of the more stable pass-catching options for head coach Ben Johnson ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 27-10 loss to the Commanders in Week 8.
news.head: Makai Lemon draws nine targets in Week 8
news.impact: Lemon led the Eagles in all receiving categories with DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both out. The rookie has been productive over his past two contests, going for 124 yards and a touchdown over that span. He will be a flex option in Week 9 vs. the Giants.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 7-of-8 targets for 67 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Makai Lemon plays well in loss Monday
news.impact: The rookie finally had a high-production game, finishing with the most receptions, receiving yards, and touchdowns out of anyone on the team on Monday night. This performance was a good sign that he's not dead in the water after a slow start to the season, but he's unlikely to keep up at this pace when DeVonta Smith (hamstring) makes his return to the lineup.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon caught three passes on six targets for 19 yards in Week 6 against Carolina.
news.head: Makai Lemon inefficient on six targets in Week 6
news.impact: Lemon had a season-high 43 yards in Week 5 but recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. With 4.5 yards per target through six games, Lemon has started slowly in his rookie year. With a backup quarterback taking over, the Eagles' offense could continue to struggle.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 5-of-7 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Makai Lemon finishes with five receptions in Week 5
news.impact: Lemon caught 10 passes over the first four weeks of the season. The first-round rookie set a new career high with five receptions in Sunday's game. With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) sidelined for the second straight game, the Eagles needed more out of their other wide receivers. Lemon helped out Sunday, but he's still yet to have a real breakout performance.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
news.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-8 targets for 19 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malachi Fields sees eight targets Sunday
news.impact: Fields was second among Giants wide receivers in targets. It didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Malachi Fields bottled up in Week 5
news.impact: Fields has made minimal impact in the New York passing attack to begin the season, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in four of five contests. The pass-catcher remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest with the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-3 targets for 52 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Malachi Fields hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Fields looked pretty good on Sunday, finishing with over 50 yards and a touchdown en route to a nice win over the Cardinals. It looks like his rookie season is not yet a wash even with QB Jaxson Dart out of the lineup, but there still isn't a big expectation of fantasy success from the young wideout at this point in the season.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 7-of-9 targets for 111 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malik Nabers totals 111 yards Sunday
news.impact: Despite the quarterback change, Nabers production remained just as dominant. He remains a WR1 moving forward.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 12-of-15 targets for 165 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malik Nabers totals 165 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was a favorable gamescript for Nabers with the Giants trailing big on the afternoon. He did not find the end zone, but made up for it yardage wise. He remains a WR1 regardless of the Giants quarterback situation.

news.body: Malik Nabers hauled in 11 of his team-leading 20 targets for 121 yards and one touchdown in the Giants' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Malik Nabers dynamic in Week 5 tie with Commanders
news.impact: Nabers has caught fire in the New York passing attack of late, finishing with over 100 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in each of his last two games. The wideout offers head coach John Harbuagh one of the few explosive pass-catching options in the New York offense ahead of a Week 6 matchup with the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Malik Nabers will be “ready to play” on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Nabers (knee) will play Sunday
news.impact: Nabers is coming off a big performance last week against the Cardinals. He should remain in fantasy lineups this week.

news.body: Malik Washington caught five of six targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Washington snags touchdown in loss to Patriots
news.impact: Washington had a score in the second quarter to put the Dolphins up by 10, led the team in receptions, and tied for the lead in targets. He's developed into a usable PPR asset this season and should have some utility next week against the Lions' secondary.

news.body: Malik Washington is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
news.head: Malik Washington (knee) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Washington will remain in the WR4 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Malik Washington was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Malik Washington (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Washington is on the injury report with a knee issue. He'll remain on the WR3 radar for fantasy managers.

news.body: Malik Washington caught 3-of-3 targets for 27 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He rushed for eight yards on two carries.
news.head: Malik Washington hauls in three passes in Week 7 win
news.impact: Washington's three targets are his lowest of the season, which comes on the heels the return of Caleb Douglas to the lineup. Washington will look to bounce back in Week 8 against New England.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 1-of-4 targets for six yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: For fantasy managers desperate enough to start Harrison, fortunately his lone catch was in the end zone. He remains in the WR4/WR5 range.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 34 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. hauls in three passes in Week 6
news.impact: Harrison was making his debut for Houston and was figured to only factor into a handful of plays. Despite that, his three receptions tie a season high and the Texans are clearly high on the 24-year-old. Harrison and the Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. (trade) will be available to play in Week 6, according to HC DeMeco Ryans.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. will play Week 6
news.impact: Houston recently made a trade to acquire Harrison from the Cardinals, and he is already going to be ready to play in time for Sunday's game against the Jaguars. He is going to be on a snap count to some degree, so fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him in his first game as a Texan this week, however.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. has been traded to the Houston Texans, per a report that came out after the Texans win over the Titans.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. headed to Houston
news.impact: Harrison had worn out his welcome in Arizona, and will now be reunited with his college QB. He will look to rebuild his value with his new team, and hopefully provide a viable No.2 target behind Nico Collins. As for the likes of Jaylin Noel, Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell, and the injured Jayden Higgins, this will certainly cap their ceilings.

news.body: Matthew Golden caught 7-of-13 targets for 79 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-19 win over the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden finds the end zone in Week 8
news.impact: Golden was questionable with shoulder and foot injuries leading into Thursday's game. He didn't seem very bothered by either, however. The first-round selection from 2025 continued his breakout season, setting a new career high with seven receptions against the Panthers' beat-up secondary. Golden also went over 75 yards for the fifth time in eight games this season.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is active for the Packers' game against the Panthers on Thursday night.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) active for TNF against Carolina
news.impact: Golden was initially questionable coming into the contest, but there was optimism that he would play. That turned out to be the case, and he will suit up against the Panthers. He should be started against a defense lacking its top two corners.

news.body: Matthew Golden is “trending toward playing” in Week 8 against the Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) trending towards playing Thursday
news.impact: Golden was listed as questionable after getting in a limited practice in the Packers lone actual practice session. He should be good to go.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) is questionable to play in Thursday night's game against the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder/foot) questionable to play Thursday
news.impact: Golden is uncertain to play on Thursday night. He's dealing with a pair of injuries right now and is officially considered questionable to play as a result. The team will make a decision about his availability closer to game time, but fantasy managers should still feel comfortable starting him if he's cleared and will see a full workload against the Panthers.

news.body: Michael Wilson hauled in eight of his team-leading 15 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown while also rushing once for 17 yards in the Cardinals' 33-30 Week 8 win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Michael Wilson leads pass-catchers in Week 8 win over Cowboys
news.impact: Wilson has made the most of a sizeable target share of late, recording over 50 receiving yards in four of his last six contests. The wideout suffered multiple broken ribs in the Week 8 win and will need to have his status monitored ahead of a Week 9 divisional matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Cardinals WR Michael Wilson told reporters that he suffered two broken ribs in Sunday's game against the Cowboys.
news.head: Michael Wilson suffered two broken ribs Sunday
news.impact: It is unclear if Wilson suffered the injury on his touchdown reception that tied the game late on Sunday. “This organization’s paying me a lot of money," he said. "So if I can muster up the strength to go play, even at 60%, I’m going to.” His status will need to be monitored in practice this upcoming week.

news.body: Michael Wilson was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Michael Wilson (ribs) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Wilson was on the practice field wearing a non-contact jersey. He should still be on track to be good to go this week.

news.body: Michael Wilson caught four of eight targets for 55 yards, while rushing twice for 11 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Michael Wilson Totals 66 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Wilson finished second on Arizona in targets and receiving yards behind Trey McBride, while also getting two carries. Eight targets are enough to keep Wilson relevant, but McBride remains the clear focal point of Arizona's passing attack. Wilson is best viewed as a matchup-dependent flex option.

news.body: Mike Evans is not practicing on Wednesday.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Evans missed the 49ers Week 7 loss against the Falcons before the bye week. His status is uncertain heading into Week 9.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters he expects Mike Evans to be good to go following the 49ers Week 8 bye week.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) expected to return after bye week
news.impact: Evans sat out the 49ers loss before the bye against the Falcons on Sunday. He'll hope to return after missing just one game.

news.body: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Evans is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He aggravated his Achilles injury last week, and with the team's bye week coming up in Week 8, they deemed it best to let him sit out this week to recover. Christian Kirk (calf) and Brandin Cooks will both see more work while he's out.

news.body: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Evans was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. He's still dealing with a lingering groin injury and also aggravated an Achilles issue last week. It looks likely that he will be sidelined this week, especially with San Francisco's bye week right around the corner in Week 8.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
news.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 74 yards in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville. Collins also added five rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Nico Collins hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
news.impact: Collins saw his production drop with C.J. Stroud spreading the ball around to 10 different pass catchers. He will look to bounce back against a weak Giants' secondary in Week 7.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 5-of-7 targets for 56 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Nico Collins sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge afternoon for Collins as Houston controlled the entire game. He will remain a WR1 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Nico Collins was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Nico Collins (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: It was a day to begin the week for Collins. He remains a locked and loaded WR1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. did not record a target in a Week 8 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. not targeted in Week 8 loss
news.impact: Cooper had logged back-to-back 100-yard performances, but was not a factor at all against Las Vegas. Adonai Mitchell saw an increase in playing time and that clearly had an impact on Cooper's playing time. Cooper and the Jets will take on the Chiefs in Week 9.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5-of-5 targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Cooper has put together back-to-back 100 yard performances for the Jets. He did the bulk of his work on receptions of 52 and 60-yards. Fantasy managers should view him as a strong option heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Raiders.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 6-of-7 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Cooper led the team in all receiving categories in the loss Sunday. Cooper had been out of action for the last four games with a high-ankle sprain. Cooper will look to continue to build rapport with QB Geno Smith in Week 7 against Miami.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will return for the Jets on Sunday against the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) to return in Week 6
news.impact: Cooper has not played since he was knocked out of the Jets' season opener with a sprained ankle. The first-round rookie has returned to limited practice sessions this week, and it was announced Friday morning that he's ready for in-game action. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) remaining out this week, Cooper should slot right in behind Garrett Wilson at wide receiver for the Jets. However, there is certainly a chance that Cooper is eased back into the mix as far as total snaps go.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-2 targets for 16 yards and gained 10 yards on one carry in Sunday's 42-7 win over the Colts.
news.head: Parker Washington catches just one pass in Week 8
news.impact: This was not the game fantasy managers expected from Washington on Sunday, but the Jaguars just didn't need to throw the ball much in order to blow out the struggling Colts. Washington's stat lines have been all over the place the last few games, but he is still the top receiving option on a high-powered offense that spreads the ball around.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

news.body: Parker Washington brought down 6-of-9 targets for 124 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Parker Washington rebounds with huge performance in Week 5
news.impact: Washington eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season on Sunday, doubling his touchdown total for the season in the process. He looked every bit the part of a dynamic WR1 on Sunday. However, the Jaguars have a plethora of talented pass catchers, and QB Trevor Lawrence does tend to spread the ball around. Still, Washington is a potent fantasy option.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for just seven yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Parker Washington held to one catch Sunday
news.impact: Washington had a total disappearing act on Sunday. He was held to just one catch for a measly seven yards against the Bengals after starting out the first three weeks of the season as a red-hot fantasy option. He should bounce back and return to being a quality starter very quickly, but seeing this kind of floor for the veteran was unexpected and not ideal for fantasy managers.

news.body: Puka Nacua hauled in 11-12 targets for 80 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-9 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Puka Nacua leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Nacua had a great game from a fantasy perspective on Sunday. He led the team in targets, receiving yards, and receiving touchdowns in a win over the Chargers, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He remains a must-start option in all league formats moving forward, which should go without saying at this point.

news.body: Puka Nacua hauled in eight of his team-leading 10 targets for 68 yards and one touchdown in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Puka Nacua finds end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Nacua has maximized his role as the primary pass-catching option, posting six or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout offers head coach Sean McVay a dynamic option in the Los Angeles passing attack when healthy, with a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Puka Nacua (calf) is officially active for Week 7 for the Los Angeles Rams against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Puka Nacua (calf) active for Week 7
news.impact: Nacua will suit up after passing through pregame checks on his injured calf, offering quarterback Matthew Stafford one of the few potential impactful pass-catching options in a banged-up Rams air attack against the Raiders Sunday.

news.body: Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable for the Rams game against the Raiders with a calf injury.
news.head: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable for Sunday
news.impact: While the calf injury was originally reported to be minor, it seems like that might have been a flat out lie. Puka could still be just fine and see a boatload of targets, but the certainty of his availability just took a big hit. Fantasy managers will need to keep a close eye on his status, especially as his game is in the late afternoon window.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught four passes for 37 yards in Sunday's 24-9 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Quentin Johnston racks up 37 yards Sunday
news.impact: Johnston didn't have a great game on Sunday. He was a solid contributor with four catches for 37 yards, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a disappointing fantasy total. He should not be started for the foreseeable future, especially with how bad this Los Angeles offense still looks.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught one pass for 57 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Quentin Johnston Makes 57-Yard Catch in Week 6
news.impact: Johnston's lone reception accounted for more than a quarter of Justin Herbert's 204 passing yards. The big play salvaged his fantasy day, but one reception isn't sustainable production. Johnston remains a volatile option until the Chargers can get him more consistent volume on a weekly basis.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Johnston was dealing with a chest injury at practice throughout the week, but it seems to be nothing more than a minor issue, as he is off of the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will play on Sunday and should see more work than usual with Tre' Harris (hamstring) set to be sidelined for the Chargers.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: Johnston's chest injury continues to linger and left him limited for another practice session on Thursday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him this week, even if he's cleared to play heading into the weekend.

news.body: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rice is dealing with a pair of injuries right now and was limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. He should still be available to play in Week 9, but we won't get an official injury decision for him until later on in the week.

news.body: Rashee Rice caught seven of eight targets for 53 yards and one touchdown in the Chiefs' 28-24 loss to the Broncos in Week 8.
news.head: Rashee Rice scores touchdown in Week 8
news.impact: Rice led Kansas City with eight targets and seven receptions. He also caught an 11-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Rice averaged just 7.6 yards per reception, but that's secondary to the usage. He remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options.

news.body: Rashee Rice will return for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) will play Sunday
news.impact: Rice will return for a big divisional matchup against Denver. He should return to being a borderline WR1/WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Rice was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He has missed a couple of games due to a pair of injuries that he's managing, but he seems to be trending the right direction for Week 8. He will be startable if active on Sunday, though his slow start to the season makes him less than a must-start option.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught 4-of-6 targets for 87 yards in Monday night's 34-17 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Rome Odunze leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Odunze looked good on Monday night. He led the team with 87 yards on four catches, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a limited fantasy total. He will likely have some boom games here and there moving forward, but it remains difficult to trust starting him on an every-week basis at this point.

news.body: Rome Odunze secured 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
